metaTitle: Technical SEO & AI Search Setup for Small Business
name: SEO & GEO
headline: Help Google and AI tools *read your website*.
promise: Technical SEO, structured data and clear answers on your pages, so search engines and AI answer tools can understand what you offer and where. Scoped and priced by written quote; rankings and citations are never promised.

included.title: Technical SEO check and fixes
included.text: We look for what stops Google reading your site, such as missing titles, blocked pages, broken links, wrong canonicals or a missing sitemap, and fix what the quote covers.

included.title: Local search basics
included.text: Your business name, phone and area written the same way across your site and profiles, and advice on your Google Business Profile if you are eligible for one.

included.title: Structured data
included.text: Schema.org markup for your business, services and questions, so machines can read the facts your pages state. It never adds ratings or reviews you do not have.

included.title: Answer-first pages
included.text: We restructure key pages so each question a customer asks gets a short, direct answer, using your content and your facts.

included.title: AI search readiness
included.text: Pages that AI answer tools can fetch and quote: clear headings, plain facts, and crawler access set the way you choose.

included.title: Search Console set up
included.text: Your site verified in Google Search Console with a sitemap submitted, so you can see the searches that find you.

process.text: We check your site and how it shows up in search today, and tell you what we found.
The fixes and pages in scope, the schedule and the price. You approve before work starts.
Technical fixes and structured data first, because content cannot help a page Google cannot read.
Key pages restructured into direct answers, then the sitemap resubmitted.

faqs.q: What is GEO, in plain words?
faqs.a: Generative engine optimisation means making your pages easy for AI answer tools such as ChatGPT search or Google's AI features to read and quote: clear facts, direct answers and pages they can fetch.
No, and nobody honestly can. Google decides rankings. We remove technical reasons a page is skipped and make what you offer clear.

faqs.q: How is GEO different from regular SEO?
faqs.a: Mostly it is the same groundwork. SEO helps a page rank in a list of results; GEO helps an AI answer tool understand and quote it. Clear facts and structure help both.

faqs.q: How long until I see results?
faqs.a: Technical fixes are done on the schedule in your quote. What Google and AI tools do with them takes weeks to months and is outside anyone's control.

faqs.q: Is SEO included in the website packages?
faqs.a: Basic technical SEO is included in every package. This service is for deeper work on an existing site, priced by written quote.

cta: Send us your website address and we will tell you what we see before quoting anything.
